greeting.response: Hello! Welcome to TechMart support. How can I help you today?

hours.response: We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM. Closed on Sundays.

shipping.response: Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days. Orders above Rs 999 ship free.

returns.response: You can return any product within 7 days of delivery for a full refund.

payment.response: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

warranty.response: All electronics come with a 1 year manufacturer warranty.

contact.response: Reach us at support@techmart.com or call 1800-123-456.
